name: Research and Innovation Program
provider: Government of Newfoundland and Labrador, Department of Jobs, Growth and Rural Development

summary.quote: The Research and Innovation Fund Program provides non-repayable contributions to non-commercial entities for the development and implementation of research and development and innovation projects to support economic development in Newfoundland and Labrador.

sources.title: Research and Innovation Program - Jobs, Growth and Rural Development
sources.terms_note: The province owns the copyright and grants the public permission to use the information on its website; third-party graphics, audio and video may not be reproduced.

funding_types.quote: The Research and Innovation Fund Program provides non-repayable contributions to non-commercial entities

cost_share.text: Normally up to 50% of total eligible project costs
cost_share.quote: The program normally provides up to 50 percent of total eligible costs of a specific project.

criteria.text: A not-for-profit applicant: academic or research institution, industry association, municipality or other not-for-profit group. Not a business
criteria.quote: Eligible applicants include: Public and not-for profit academic and research institutions Industry associations Municipalities Other not-for-profit groups including economic development organizations

criteria.text: The money is for a research and development or innovation project
criteria.quote: for the development and implementation of research and development and innovation projects

criteria.text: The project fits strategic priorities and industry needs and could have an economic impact in the province
criteria.quote: Projects must align with strategic priorities, industry needs, development opportunities, and demonstrates potential for economic impact in NL.

contacts.label: Economic development (email)
contacts.quote: For program details or assistance with your application, contact economicdevelopment@gov.nl.ca

research.notes: The page names the program 'Research and Innovation Program' in its title and heading and 'Research and Innovation Fund Program' in its text; the name follows the heading. It is for non-commercial entities only, so a business misses the structure rule; kept in the data because the brief lists it and a non-profit owner may use the tool. 'Other not-for-profit groups' gives nonprofit; a co-operative may or may not be not-for-profit, so it is unclear. Municipalities and public institutions aren't profile options. Location: the page says the projects support economic development in NL but gives no rule on where the applicant is, so no location rule. Intake: not stated, so unknown. No maximum amount on the page. The factsheet and application are PDFs/forms and were not read. Research applicants with MUN and CNA have an extra rule (full-time for two or more years), not added: it applies to individual researchers, not the organization.
